releases.title: Device bookmarks, a new popup, and Supporter perks
releases.summary: Device bookmarks with no account needed, a redesigned toolbar popup, Top Moments cards in line, and Supporter perks, purchase and recovery for when Supporter sign-ups open.
preview: Bookmark moments without an account; they stay on this device.
The toolbar popup shows channels Pulse is charting live and jumps back to your recent moments.
Picking a Top Moments row opens its card right under that row.
new: Bookmarks work without an account: saves stay on this device and are never uploaded. Once an account is linked, My Moments lists them under Saved on this device.
The toolbar popup is redesigned. Away from a stream it lists channels Pulse is charting live and a Jump back in card for your recent moments and device saves.
Picking a Top Moments row opens its moment card directly under that row, so the rows above it stay in place.
Supporters can paint the panel title with their finish, a wave and a sheen, and show a tenure crest that grows with their support.

Become a Supporter opens streampulse.stream, where you sign in and approve this extension before paying on Stripe. Where the server allows it, Stripe opens directly instead, without a website sign-in or device code.
Membership management and recovery stay connected to the extension's own account.
improved: Quick settings open on a Watching card for the current channel, with the Supporter card under it and Open all settings pinned at the bottom.
The 7TV header backdrop (Still or Rain) is now a Supporter perk and is off by default. The panel title stays free, and a saved backdrop choice is kept for when you support.
fixed: When StreamPulse cannot be reached on first load, Pulse says so and offers Retry instead of showing Loading forever.
Hiding Pulse in the right or bottom dock no longer draws a large dark shape over the page.
VODs without replay data no longer show a false outage or raw error codes.
Analytics links keep a moment in the stream's first minute, and a link without a stream no longer selects a minute in a different stream.
While a linked account's connection is renewing, bookmarks stay with the account and report that it is unreachable instead of saving on this device and then dropping out of view.
A temporary connection error no longer immediately discards an installation account's credential.
Unpaid checkout stays available to reopen, with automatic checks bounded to thirty minutes.
Old restore notices no longer hide verified membership management.
knownIssues: Supporter sign-ups are not yet open to everyone.
Bookmarks saved on this device before linking an account are not added to the account.

releases.title: Selected-minute clarity and complete extension settings
releases.summary: Exact bucket selection, honest viewer history, refined chart motion, validated Twitch VOD playback windows, and a complete responsive settings workspace.
preview: Selected minutes use a compact moment layout with exact metrics, top emotes, and player actions.
All charts open on Full stream with exact bucket locking.
Viewer lines preserve honest sampling gaps while settings stay synchronized across extension surfaces.
new: Clicking a chart bucket opens a compact selected-minute card with chat, emote, and viewer readouts plus Jump and Open Analytics actions.
Hovering the chart previews a bucket read-only, so a moving pointer never offers actions that vanish.
Top-emote thumbnails in the selected-minute card show a hover preview with the emote name, provider, and use count.
Viewer-sampler health is reported separately from API connectivity, distinguishing an older backend, disabled sampling, active writes, and failures.
improved: Live, offline, and VOD charts open on Full stream; changing the range affects only the current view.
The viewer lane draws one continuous line with no persistent dots, and a sampled zero stays a real observation.
Chart hover and lock now identify the exact bucket and its chat and emote bars.
Selected-minute metrics read Viewers, Chat/min, Emotes/min, with emote chips using a fixed multiplier count.
Quick settings on Twitch now include auto-update, branded accents, overlay placement, the chat-closed dock, and an expandable three-item What's new preview.
The full options page is now the complete settings home for Twitch controls, privacy and cache controls, updates, changelog history, and development-only tools.
The responsive settings workspace uses one normal scroll owner, synchronized immediate-save controls, and section navigation that adapts to narrow layouts.
Chart previews, selected minutes, range menus, and settings transitions use lightweight motion with reduced-motion support.
Live polling exposes its state, so a toggle issues exactly one request.
fixed: Full stream charts now merge recent chat, emote, and viewer minutes into retained history, and refresh game history after a live category change.
A locked bucket keeps its highlight and both bar lanes visible after the pointer leaves the plot, and clears on a second click.
Selecting a ranked Top Moment while a minute is locked no longer loses the click to the outside-click handler.
The viewer line no longer synthesises minutes before sampling began, and no longer overwrites sampled zeroes.
Chart downsampling no longer lends one minute's peak viewer count to a different minute's bar.
Emote thumbnails no longer flicker when moving between adjacent buckets.
Approximate clock prefixes were removed from moment times.
Viewer-sampling health now reaches the extension UI, including hosted and local mode drift.
Offline and VOD recap charts honour the reduced-motion preference.
VOD timelines and moments are constrained to the exact Twitch playback window, so corrupt outlier minutes cannot stretch the chart or issue impossible seeks.
Opening overlay settings reuses the cached health result, while the Test button still performs an explicit fresh check.
The Volt accent now renders with its intended orange palette across quick and full settings instead of the previous green treatment.
knownIssues: Viewer history is collected prospectively; minutes missed before sampling was enabled are not backfilled.
A live stream may not expose a VOD id until Twitch publishes the archive after the stream ends.

releases.title: Private beta preview
releases.summary: Local tester preview used to validate the Twitch overlay, hosted connectivity, and packaging. It was never published to a store.
new: An internal preview established the StreamPulse Twitch overlay and analytics connection flow.
knownIssues: This preview is not a production release and may include local package cohorts.
